items.full: I prefer working in a team because it helps me solve problems more effectively. First, team members can share different perspectives, so we can find better solutions. For example, during a project at work, we had trouble organizing our schedule. One coworker suggested a shared calendar, and another divided the tasks by priority. As a result, we finished everything on time. Also, teamwork motivates me when a task becomes stressful. I can ask for feedback instead of spending too much time alone. Of course, working independently is useful for tasks that require concentration. However, for most projects, I believe teamwork leads to better results.
